context: Daichi and Riku talk about a market find.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (久々/そのうち/コレクション/損/どころ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 久々に、骨董市に行ってきたで。
lines.en: I went to an antique market after a while.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: コレクションにええ品が、あったんよ。
lines.en: There was a great piece for my collection.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 高かったら、損じゃない?
lines.en: If pricey, isn't it a loss?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 損どころか、お買い得やったわ。
lines.en: Far from a loss, it was a bargain.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コレクション、見せてよ!
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そのうち、家で見せたるわ。
lines.en: I'll show you at home sometime.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 久々に、骨董って面白そうだね!
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm closing delivery throughout
